title: hibi mark --stdin input
description: Standard input of `mark --stdin`: a non-empty array.

MarkInput.description:
One claim to mark: an argument of `hibi mark`, or one element of its
standard-input array (a claim id string, or this object).

claim.description: A claim id or id prefix (section 3.6).

MarkStdinElement.description:
One element of the standard input of `mark --stdin`: a claim id, or an
object with the id and an optional note and actor.
